gates.principle: The V2.5 reference and its hashes never change
gates.enforced_by: CI required check: Immutable V2.5 integrity

gates.principle: src/ changes only through a reviewed candidate scope
gates.enforced_by: CI required check: Boundary hardening candidate (validation.candidate_integrity)

gates.principle: No secrets, credentials or known private patterns in public diffs
gates.enforced_by: CI required check: scan-publication-diff (security/publication_guard.py, enforcing copy taken from the base branch)

gates.principle: main changes only by squash-merged PRs with checks green; no force push or deletion
gates.enforced_by: Ruleset "Push Protection" (required: Immutable V2.5 integrity, Boundary hardening candidate, scan-publication-diff, brain-records); re-checked on read by python3 -m brain status (tests/test_findings.py::RepoSettings)

gates.principle: Evidence branches and release tags cannot be deleted or rewritten
gates.enforced_by: Rulesets "Preserve evidence branches" and "Protect release tags"; re-checked on read by python3 -m brain status (tests/test_findings.py::RepoSettings)

gates.principle: Brain records follow the record contract; no contradictory current decisions
gates.enforced_by: python -m brain validate; tests/test_brain.py and tests/test_findings.py; required check brain-records (workflow brain.yml)

gates.principle: No unasked generation, spend, publication or contact
gates.enforced_by: Benchmark check C1/C2, re-run per ADR-0005 D1.4

gates.principle: Claims only from the facts sheet
No private storage locators or operator-account statements in the shipped skill
gates.enforced_by: tests/test_findings.py::SrcExposure in required check brain-records (workflow brain.yml)

gates.principle: Living docs do not describe merged PRs as open or proposed
gates.enforced_by: python -m brain lint-docs in required check brain-records

gates.principle: Media or binary files in a PR carry a recorded human review (rights, likeness, EXIF)
gates.enforced_by: Required check scan-publication-diff fails without a "Media reviewed:" line in the PR description

gates.principle: Publication check before every local push
gates.enforced_by: security/install_hooks.py pre-push hook (local; install once per clone)

gates.principle: No owner-environment or account details in public text
gates.enforced_by: Human review, prompted by the PR template checklist; the pattern scanner cannot judge meaning

gates.principle: A second reviewer for changes to main
gates.enforced_by: Waived by the owner (DEC-2026-10-30-review-model); compensated by required checks, rulesets and owner-only merges

gates.principle: Third-party Actions pinned by commit SHA
gates.enforced_by: tests/test_findings.py::ActionsPinning in workflow brain.yml: every uses: is a full commit SHA
